Their first short walk was not the adventure he had imagined. Fern stopped often to smell the same patch of grass. Sam wanted to ____5____, but his mother asked him to give her time while keeping the lead secure.

At home, Fern returned to the mat by the door. Sam placed the ball nearby, then left it alone. That evening, he heard a soft ____6____. The ball rolled across the floor, pushed by Fern's nose.
